about: A dungeon rework can leave the creatures it replaced in the client, beside the new ones. RealmEye then writes one page per creature, about the one played now. `generations` names the client working-id prefix of the retired and of the reworked objects of a dungeon: where both hold the same display name, tools/build-index.js lets a reworked one carry the row, and tools/database/export_realmeye_enrichment.py sends the page's relations to it. `pages` covers a creature the rework also renamed, so no shared name ties the two: the Index id of the retired record, then the id of the record its page belongs to, read by tools/index-wiki.js and tools/database/realmeye_archive_import.py. `slugs` covers a page whose creature the client shows under another display name, so no name can find it and another creature of the page's name took it: the RealmEye page slug, then the Index id of the record whose life and defence the page states.
